editorial:
Imagine moving to a whole new country just to start a family. That is exactly what you see here, as a couple heads to Bulgaria for fertility treatments. At first, it feels like a hopeful journey, but things take a dark turn very quickly. After a freak accident leads to the death of a child, the story shifts from a romance into a heavy look at guilt and grief. You will feel the tension build up as the couple tries to deal with the weight of what happened, making you wonder if they can ever truly move past the tragedy.

The acting is the strongest part of the film because the emotions feel real and raw. While the story moves a bit slow in the middle, the payoff is worth it for anyone who likes deep, emotional stories. If you are in the mood for something serious, you should definitely check it out. For the best experience, I suggest streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to catch all the details, or you can rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night. Adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is also a great move if you love collecting high-quality dramas.
endingExplained: The movie ends with the couple facing the crushing reality of their actions. They cannot escape the guilt of the child's death, and their relationship falls apart under the pressure. Instead of a happy ending, you see them broken and unable to find peace. The final scenes show that some mistakes are too big to fix, leaving you with a sad feeling as the credits roll and the story closes.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves intense character studies and emotional dramas.
